translations.web: When the wicked turns from his wickedness, and does that which is lawful and right, he will live by it.
translations.bsb: But if a wicked man turns from his wickedness and does what is just and right, he will live because of this.
translations.kjv: But if the wicked turn from his wickedness, and do that which is lawful and right, he shall live
translations.asv: And when the wicked turneth from his wickedness, and doeth that which is lawful and right, he shall live thereby.
